create_ddim_scheduler: create a DDIMScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and prediction type for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps_ddim: set the discrete timesteps for the DDIM scheduler before running the denoising inference loop
step_ddim_denoising: perform one denoising step with the DDIM scheduler to predict the previous timestep sample
add_noise_ddim: add noise to original samples using the DDIM scheduler for the forward diffusion training process
build_beta_schedule: build a beta schedule tensor using betas_for_alpha_bar with cosine, exp, or laplace transform types
